 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Tennessee (4-0) will travel to Belmont (1-3) for an in-state basketball game on Tuesday.
 Tipoff between the Lady Vols and Bruins in slated for 7:30 p.m. EST at Curb Event Center in Nashville, Tennessee. The contest can be watched on ESPN+.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement A win Tuesday would match the third-best start for Tennessee head coach Kim Caldwell in her career. She started 29-0 at Glenville State in the 2021-22 season. During her first season as head coach of the Lady Vols, she led Tennessee to 13 consecutive victories to open the 2024-25 campaign.
 Caldwell started the 2018-19 season 5-0 at Glenville State, her third best start of her career.
 A win on Tuesday would also be the Lady Vols' first victory against Belmont in Nashville. Tennessee is 0-4 against the Bruins all time in Nashville.
 Tennessee last played the Bruins in Nashville during the 1976-77 season. Belmont earned a, 60-59, victory on Jan. 28, 1977.
